latest.title: Logo Squircle, Noise Grain Toggle & Dynamic App Identity
latest.summary: Added dark macOS squircle background to the logo across all themes, resolved the noise grain toggle switch, and made bundle identifiers and paths fully dynamic.

highlights.title: Persistent Dark Logo Background
highlights.description: Added dark macOS squircle background to the logo so the white icon stays crisp and visible in both light and dark themes.

highlights.title: Film Grain Toggle Switch Fix
highlights.description: Fixed the settings toggle switch to reliably enable and disable tactile noise grain texture across all intensity levels.

highlights.title: Dynamic Identity & Seamless Migration
highlights.description: Removed hardcoded user paths and identifiers with automated migration from legacy app data folders.
